title: GaN/SiC cascade-NEMD: code and data for "Spurious enhancement of thermal boundary conductance in cascade-NEMD simulations of GaN/SiC caused by damage-amplified integration error"
description: LAMMPS inputs, interatomic potentials, analysis scripts, processed data and figures accompanying the manuscript submitted to Computational Materials Science (COMMAT-D-26-04311). Raw logs, temperature profiles and structures of the 165 original runs are archived separately.
